description: Contract for configuration-driven case-study pipeline dry runs. This is a lightweight schema document, not executable code.

adapter_id.meaning: Adapter ID from the explicit adapter registry. User configs cannot provide module_path or callable_name.

input_artifacts.meaning: Artifact IDs from the artifact registry

validator.meaning: Validation policy ID from the validation registry

trust_policy.meaning: Trust policy ID from the trust registry

rules: credentials are never stored in config files

dry_run.v2_0_policy: true is the only supported execution mode

execution_mode.meaning: Controlled execution mode. v2.0.3 only approves reliability trust verify.

write_manifest.meaning: When true, dry-run may write exactly one local run manifest.

rules: absolute paths and traversal are prohibited
outputs/platform_runs is the default local-only location
must remain under outputs/platform_runs for executable adapters
can only make the configured resource budget stricter
cannot grant network, raw data, model training, process spawning, or overwrite permission

security_rules: Config files contain metadata only and no executable code.
Python expressions, eval, exec, shell commands, and arbitrary imports are prohibited.
Artifact references use registry IDs rather than absolute local paths.
Path traversal and credentials are prohibited.
Executable permission, network permission, raw-data permission, model-training permission, process spawning, and canonical overwrite permission cannot be enabled from config.
